نبتلي (form VIII)
# نَبْتَلِي (nabtalī) /nab.ta.liː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# نَبْتَلِيَ (nabtaliya) /nab.ta.li.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
